name: Phase 01: Indian Cash Defense & Daily Habit Architecture
modern_highlight: Money Works (Deepak Shenoy) & Same as Ever (Morgan Housel)
anchor_classic: Let's Talk Money (Monika Halan) & Atomic Habits (James Clear)
mission: Build the unshakeable personal cash flow foundation in India: emergency fund, term insurance, health cover, zero bad debt, and daily habit architecture.

name: Phase 02: 2024-2026 Modern AI Engineering & Production LLMs
modern_highlight: The Thinking Machine (2025), Supremacy (2024) & AI Engineering (2025)
anchor_classic: Why Machines Learn (2025) & The LLM Engineer Handbook (2025)
mission: Master foundation models, GPU compute bottlenecks (Nvidia), production RAG architectures, prompt-to-code pipelines, and LangGraph agentic workflows.

name: Phase 03: Machine Learning, Data Science & AI Foundations
modern_highlight: Hands-On Machine Learning & Deep Learning with Python
anchor_classic: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (Russell & Norvig)
mission: Ground generative AI in solid mathematical statistics, vector embeddings, loss functions, transformer attention mechanics, and ML pipelines.

name: Phase 04: Senior Systems Architecture & Staff Engineering
anchor_classic: Designing Data-Intensive Applications & System Design Interview
mission: Master distributed storage engines, replication, consensus (Raft/Paxos), microservices decomposition, and staff-level architectural trade-offs.

name: Phase 05: Clean Code, Software Craft & TCS Escape Leverage
modern_highlight: Staff Engineer (Will Larson) & The Staff Engineer Path (Tanya Reilly)
anchor_classic: Clean Code, The Pragmatic Programmer & Cracking the Coding Interview
mission: Transform from a corporate services cog into an elite product-tier engineer commanding top-percentile CTC and global remote compensation.

name: Phase 06: Indian Capital Markets & Compounding Champions
modern_highlight: The Sacred Truths of Investing (2025) & Money Works (Deepak Shenoy)
anchor_classic: Coffee Can Investing (Saurabh Mukherjea) & Diamonds in the Dust
mission: Master the Indian equity landscape: identify clean accounting, high ROCE moats, pricing power, and long-term compounding machines in the Indian economy.

name: Phase 07: Investment Philosophy, Margin of Safety & Value Allocation
modern_highlight: 1929: Inside the Greatest Crash in Wall Street History (2025)
anchor_classic: The Intelligent Investor (Benjamin Graham) & One Up On Wall Street
mission: Internalize Mr. Market, margin of safety, risk mitigation, and emotional resilience to preserve capital during euphoric tops and panic bottoms.

name: Phase 08: Micro-SaaS, Bootstrapping & Independent Digital Assets
anchor_classic: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant (Eric Jorgenson)
mission: Leverage permissionless code and media to build micro-SaaS, digital products, and recurring revenue tools that decouple time from income.

name: Phase 09: The Fastlane, Startup Velocity & Unscripted Wealth
modern_highlight: Unscripted: The Great Rat Race Escape & Amp It Up (Frank Slootman)
anchor_classic: The Millionaire Fastlane (MJ DeMarco) & Zero to One (Peter Thiel)
mission: Break free from the Slowlane 40-year cubicle script by understanding scalable business systems, asymmetric risk, and technological monopolies.

name: Phase 10: Behavioral Finance, Financial Crises & Credit Markets
modern_highlight: The Fund (Ray Dalio) & Going Infinite (Michael Lewis)
anchor_classic: Early Retirement Extreme & The Book on Rental Property
mission: Understand financial bubbles, systemic contagion, behavioral heuristics, credit markets, fixed income, and defensive cash-flow real estate.

name: Phase 11: Tech Geopolitics, Semiconductor Wars & Global Macro
anchor_classic: Chip War (Chris Miller) & Principles for Navigating Big Debt Crises
mission: Grasp the global macroeconomic chessboard: semiconductor lithography, export sanctions, sovereign debt cycles, currency wars, and supply chain chokepoints.

name: Phase 12: Charlie Munger's Mental Models & Decision Science
anchor_classic: Poor Charlie's Almanack & Thinking, Fast and Slow (Kahneman)
mission: Build a multidisciplinary latticework of mental models: inversion, probabilistic thinking, superforecasting, and cognitive bias mitigation.

name: Phase 13: High-Stakes Negotiation, Sales & Persuasion Mastery
anchor_classic: Never Split the Difference (Chris Voss) & Influence (Robert Cialdini)
mission: Master tactical empathy, calibrated negotiation, executive communication, and high-stakes distribution power to win top contracts and deals.

name: Phase 14: Deep Work, Peak Performance & Rapid Learning
modern_highlight: Slow Productivity (Cal Newport 2024) & Hidden Potential (Adam Grant)
anchor_classic: Deep Work (Cal Newport) & Peak: Secrets of Expertise (Anders Ericsson)
mission: Eliminate cognitive fragmentation, master deliberate practice, and execute high-velocity intellectual output without burnout.

name: Phase 15: Quantitative Math, Strategic Moats & Institutions
modern_highlight: 7 Powers: Foundations of Business Strategy & Good to Great
anchor_classic: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS) & The Signal and the Noise
mission: Understand mathematical foundations, corporate economic moats, institutional governance, law, and probabilistic systems.

name: Phase 16: Stoic Wisdom, Physical Longevity & Sovereign Freedom
modern_highlight: Outlive: Science of Longevity (Peter Attia) & Four Thousand Weeks
anchor_classic: Mastery (Robert Greene), Meditations & The Courage to Be Disliked
mission: Ensure the wealth and career freedom you build is crowned with supreme physical health, longevity, inner peace, and sovereign self-determination.
